page.overview:
Who is Insomniac?

Insomniac wears a grey trench coat over a red full body suit, on his head he wears a Red and yellow helmet that has pins to keep his eyes open. He appears to have strabismus as seen by his eyes pointing in different directions, this could also be an animation mistake.

There is an game company called Insomniac Games, responsible for the recent ongoing Spider-Man Game Series. Category:Humans Category:Supervillains Category:The Order
